release_title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：全新架构，迈向极致性价比（architecture preview for Qwen4）

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.variant: 125B main params + 51B N-gram embedding, 6B activated/token; GDN+QSA hybrid, Gated Residual, N-gram Embedding, Muon; native 262,144 context (YaRN to 1M)
models.capability_summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 被发布文定位为迈向极致性价比的全新架构预览（GDN+QSA 混合注意力、N-gram Embedding、Muon 优化器），为 Qwen4 架构探路。评测覆盖代理编码/办公、多模态代理与通用推理：SWE-bench Pro 62.5、CoWorkBench 73.9、Toolathlon Verified 73.5、AndroidWorld 84.5。

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Base
models.capability_summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Base 是同架构的预训练基座版本（未做后训练），发布文表 3 单独报告其通用、数学 STEM、编码与多语言基线：MMLU 90.36、BBH 90.87、GSM8K 93.29。

notes: Release date: qwen.ai research index card 'Qwen3.8-Flash-Next：全新架构，迈向极致性价比 | 2026/08/26'; OpenRouter lists qwen3.8-flash created 2026-08-26 (team lead's mapping: qwen3.8-flash = this release). Positioning: open-weights multimodal MoE and structural preview of Qwen4 (role analogous to Qwen3-Next for Qwen3.5); the GDN+Gated Attention hybrid introduced there was subsequently used across Qwen3.5-3.8. Cost claim: training cost ~1/9 of Qwen3.7-Plus with stronger coding/office capability. All three tables are DOM tables -> rows verified. Instruct-table columns: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Qwen3.8-27B | Qwen3.7-Plus | DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 | Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max). Multimodal columns: Flash-Next | Qwen3.8-27B | Qwen3.7-Plus | Opus-4.6 (Max). Base columns: Flash-Next-Base | Qwen3.8-27B-Base | Qwen3.7-Plus-Base; base-table external data note absent (Qwen technical report referenced on the Seed1.6-style note pattern is not repeated here). Technical report on GitHub per page.
